Outside mathematics, I enjoy Carnatic and Hindustani classical music, and I play the
bansuri (Indian bamboo flute).

## T. M. Krishna

My favorite artist is **T. M. Krishna** (Thodur Madabusi Krishna), the Carnatic
vocalist. I love his music. Some performances I enjoy:

- [Ragam Nalinakanthi](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5yZEsJDJ9yc)
- [Ragam Khamas](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7A0YSVf-z3c)
- [*Bhaja Govindam*, with Vikku Vinayakram](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4xJtWPYj4lg)
